ivy (Product): @channel Heads-up: Hosted streaming tool-call v3 is GA 🚀

ivy (Product): Quick summary: unified streaming/tool-calling surface, improved backpressure handling, and a new best-effort tool-resolver to reduce cold-tool latency. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/streaming-toolcall-v3

mike (Eng Runtime): Noted. Runtime got a new backpressure circuit and a soft-queue to avoid OOMs for long-lived streams. We'll instrument per-route queue depth.

mike (Eng Runtime): Question for DevEx: will SDKs expose stream.retryPolicy or do we keep it server-side?

tara (DevEx): tara: We'll add client-side retry helpers (python/ts) but default to server-managed backoff. Will publish examples today.

ci-bot: Canary deploy: streaming-toolcall-v3 -> canary-wns (nodes=12) at 2026-07-02T09:10:02Z. Monitor: https://ops.redwood.ai/canaries/streaming-toolcall-v3

ivy (Product): Migration notes: old streaming-toolcall-v2 remains supported for 30 days; we recommend customers move to v3 for latency-sensitive flows. We'll add a deprecation banner in Console after 7 days.

mike (Eng Runtime): I'll add telemetry for tool-resolver latency and fallback counts. If fallbacks exceed 5% for a route, trigger an alert.

ivy (Product): Thanks all — marketing will schedule external announcement tomorrow. If you see any regressions during canary ping me directly.
